summary:
Results inbox worked per RBC-INBOX-01, RBC-LAB-03, RBC-RAD-05. Original 8 items plus 5 that arrived during work:

- pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT urogram (task-00001): incidental 4 mm LLL nodule already followed in lung screening. Initially ordered 12-month LDCT (sr-t0001) + tracking, messaged, note. ARRIVAL (inbox-a0001): Lakeshore addendum revised the 2026-04-14 LDCT to Lung-RADS 3 (new 5 mm RUL nodule), LDCT in 6 months -> plan corrected: new LDCT sr-t0029 (window to 2026-11-14), tracking task task-t0030 due 2026-11-14, task-t0031 to scheduling to not schedule/discontinue superseded sr-t0001 (no tool to cancel ServiceRequests; old tracking task task-t0002 also superseded), corrected patient message, note doc-t0033. Closed.
- pt-0016: TSH normal (task-00010) closed; K first reported 6.3 was corrected to 4.4 (analyzer fault) -> no action (task-00011) closed.
- pt-0007 Leslie Parisian: CTA preliminary (task-00003) acted on final dr-00084 - no PE, "nodule" is a vessel, no follow-up -> closed. BMP 10/22 (task-00004): Cr 1.64 vs 0.98 within 48 h = AKI -> urgent repeat BMP sr-t0010 by 10/26, urgent patient message, note, closed. ARRIVAL inbox-a0002 (preliminary CXR, possible RUL nodule): no final report issued -> LEFT OPEN per §2c.
- pt-0064 Helen Marchetti: Cr 1.36 (9/26) and arrival Cr 1.48 (10/22) - no prior creatinine within 48 h/7 days, AKI rule not met -> both closed, no action.
- pt-0033 Carol Whitfield: Cr 1.31 (task-00025) not AKI (entered-in-error 0.84 excluded; 1.27 on 10/17) -> closed. ARRIVAL inbox-a0004: Cr 1.78 at 19:40 same day vs 1.31 = AKI -> urgent repeat BMP sr-t0024 by 10/26, urgent message, note, closed.
- pt-0008 Walter Brennan: K 6.4 flagged hemolyzed (task-00005) -> urgent repeat BMP sr-t0015, patient message, note, closed. ARRIVAL inbox-a0005: lab correction says NOT hemolyzed -> decision changed to RBC-LAB-03 §1: STAT BMP today sr-t0019 (supersedes sr-t0015), stat message to pool-oncall, corrected patient message (come in today), meds reviewed - no K-raising drugs to hold, addendum note doc-t0022, closed.

Follow-up for you: sr-t0001 (pt-0006) and sr-t0015 (pt-0008) are superseded orders that I couldn't cancel with the tools I have, so they need to be discontinued manually. inbox-a0002 is still open until the final CXR report comes in. The messages queue (refill requests) wasn't part of this request and hasn't been touched.
